turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. Hello, Mr Lim. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak privately? We can keep the call brief if you have another appointment coming up.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hi Rachel, Adrian here. Yes, I'm in my office with the door closed. I've set aside a little time before my next meeting, so now is a good time.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Before we get into the main part of the call, may I take your identification details for verification? I'll wait while you get settled.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'm ready. My NRIC is S four five four three four seven two K. My date of birth is 30 April 1997.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for that. I'll keep the conversation direct. Let me confirm your objective: you want to build wealth over the long term through diversified exposure to global equities.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I've prepared my notes, so let me give you the details together. The product I want to transact in is Summit Global Equity ETF. I want to buy. Please use euros as the transaction currency. The amount I am committing to this transaction is 50,000. The quantity I want is 100 units. Please place this as a market order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll cover the required points now. For Summit Global Equity ETF, a decline in global equity markets can reduce the value of its underlying holdings. During volatile or illiquid markets, its traded price can also differ from its underlying asset value. Do you understand that market declines can reduce the fund's value, and that its traded price may differ from its underlying asset value?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand both risks: the holdings can fall in value, and the trading price may not match the underlying asset value.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You could lose some or even all of the capital you invest in this fund. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including a substantial reduction in the capital you put in?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses, including a substantial reduction in my invested capital.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I guarantee that this investment will deliver positive returns in the future. Before the final readback, is telephone still your preferred way for us to contact you about account administration?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, please call me directly. During consultancy meetings I usually leave my phone on silent. If I miss you, leave a brief message with your name and I'll return the call when I'm free.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Noted. There's no need to discuss private account information in a voicemail. Will you be travelling soon, or should we continue using your usual contact arrangements?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'll be away next week for work, mostly meeting clients. My mobile will still be with me. Afternoons are generally easier, but please message first so I can find a quiet place to talk.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That's helpful, thank you. We can arrange future conversations around your availability. Let me return to the readback now. Please confirm your final instruction: buy 100 units of Summit Global Equity ETF using a market order, with a transaction amount of 50,000 in euros. Is that the instruction you want me to proceed with?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that is my final transaction instruction. Please proceed.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Mr Lim. We'll use the usual secure channel for the account paperwork. If you're travelling when it arrives, you can access it whenever you're somewhere private.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Okay, that suits me. I prefer keeping the paperwork separate from my work email. If there's an administrative question, a quick phone call is easier than a long email exchange.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I've noted your contact preference. Thank you for making time this morning, and have a good trip. I'll let you get back to your meeting.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Rachel. Appreciate you keeping the call focused. Speak another time. Bye.
